versions.changelog: Critical security fix: Prevent arbitrary file read via --template parameter. Added directory whitelist, file extension validation, and JSON format validation.
Critical security fix: Remove command injection vulnerability

- Initial release of feishu-interactive-cards skill.
- Create and send interactive cards to Feishu (Lark) with buttons, forms, polls, and various UI elements.
- Automatic handling of user interaction callbacks via a long-polling server.
- Provides ready-to-use templates for confirmations, todos, polls, and forms.
- Guidance and best practices for when to use interactive cards vs. plain text in Feishu messages.
- Integration instructions for OpenClaw agents and gateway.
